plan_metadata.name: group  login m365 only with copilot account

steps.description: Press the F1 key to open the command palette in Visual Studio Code.
Type text 'View: show microsoft' into the Visual Studio Code command palette (top input bar) to trigger the 'View: Show Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit' command from the dropdown suggestions.
Press the 'Enter' key to confirm the selection of "View: Show Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit" from the dropdown list in the Visual Studio Code command palette.
Press the F1 key to open the Command Palette in Visual Studio Code while viewing the "Overview of the Basic Custom Engine Agent template" in the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit interface.
Type the text 'Microsoft 365 Agents: Accounts' into the Visual Studio Code command palette input field.
Click the first result, "Microsoft 365 Agents: Accounts", above the similarly named "Accounts: Manage Accounts" command.
Click the "Sign in to Microsoft 365" option from the dropdown menu in the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit section of the Visual Studio Code interface.
Click the "Sign in" button within the Microsoft 365 developer sandbox modal.
Click on the "Email or phone" input field in the Microsoft Sign-in form on the login.microsoftonline.com webpage to focus the cursor for credential entry.
Enter ${{env:M365_ACCOUNT_NAME_EnableCopilotAccess}} into the email or username input field on the Microsoft Sign in page at login.microsoftonline.com in a Chrome browser.
Click the blue "Next" button on the Microsoft sign-in page, confirming the entered email address for login.
Type ${{secret:M365_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_EnableCopilotAccess}} into the 'Password' field on the Microsoft login page.
Press the "Enter" key to submit the login form on the Microsoft password entry screen labeled "Enter password."
Click the "Close" (X) button in the browser window's title bar to close the browser window.
